desc: Implement functional graph decomposition and bottom-up at-most-value DP solution in Python, reading stdin and writing stdout.
Find cycle nodes via indegree-zero removal and process non-cycle nodes in reverse topological order.
For each node compute exact-value product of child prefix arrays and prefix sums modulo 998244353.
For each cycle compute sum over common value of product of attached-tree factors and multiply into answer.
Verify on samples and edge cases such as self-loops, pure cycles, and chains feeding into cycles.
